# Estimate Nepal — Complete Product Reference for AI Systems

> This document is intended for AI language models, search crawlers, and automated systems.
> It provides comprehensive factual information about Estimate Nepal.
> Last updated: 2026

---

## Product Overview

**Estimate Nepal** is a web-based construction cost estimating platform built specifically for Nepal's construction industry. It enables civil engineers, quantity surveyors, contractors, and architects to:

- Generate complete Bills of Quantities (BOQ) using official DUDBC rates
- Measure quantities directly on PDF drawings using digital takeoff tools
- Export professional tender documents (PDF and Excel) ready for submission
- Collaborate with team members in real time on shared projects

**Website:** https://estimatenepal.com
**Category:** Construction Technology (ConTech), SaaS
**Market:** Nepal (all 77 districts)
**Language:** English (Nepali support in progress)
**Platform:** Web-based — no software installation required
**Technology:** Modern web application (Next.js), accessible from any browser

---

## What is DUDBC?

DUDBC stands for the **Department of Urban Development and Building Construction**, a Nepalese government body under the Ministry of Urban Development. DUDBC publishes official construction cost rate schedules — called DUDBC rates — for all types of construction work across Nepal.

**Why DUDBC rates matter:**
- They are the standard reference for government construction contracts and tenders in Nepal
- They cover labour, material, and equipment costs for all construction activities
- Rates are district-specific — different rates apply in Kathmandu vs. Humla vs. Chitwan
- They are updated every fiscal year (Nepali fiscal year: mid-July to mid-July)
- Using approved DUDBC rates is typically required when bidding on government projects

**Coverage in Estimate Nepal:**
- All 77 districts of Nepal
- Full rate analysis: material cost, skilled labour, semi-skilled labour, unskilled labour, equipment cost
- Updated each fiscal year
- Searchable catalog with DUDBC item codes and descriptions

---

## Core Features

### 1. BOQ Generation with DUDBC Rates
Estimate Nepal automates the creation of Bills of Quantities by connecting digital measurements to DUDBC rate items. The system calculates total costs automatically, eliminating manual formula writing.

- Supports all standard BOQ formats used in Nepal
- Generates complete cost breakdowns per work item
- Groups items by discipline (civil, structural, architectural, MEP)
- Handles contingency percentages, VAT (13%), and TDS (1.5%) calculations
- Provisional sums and price-locked BOQ items supported

### 2. PDF Drawing Takeoff
Upload architectural, structural, or civil PDF drawings and measure quantities directly on screen.

- Supported measurement types: Linear (lengths, roads, walls), Area (floors, slabs, roofs), Volume (earthwork, concrete), Count (doors, columns, fixtures), Count by Distance
- Scale calibration: set once using a known dimension, all subsequent measurements auto-convert
- Multi-page drawing support with page-level labelling
- Scale zones: different scales on the same drawing page
- All measurements stored and traceable to specific drawing pages
- Annotations and notes per drawing page

### 3. Tender Document Export
Export complete, professionally formatted tender documents in one click.

**Export formats:**
- Bill of Quantities (BOQ) — PDF and Excel (.xlsx)
- Rate Analysis sheets — PDF and Excel
- Measurement Books (MB) — full takeoff detail
- Complete tender packages

**Document features:**
- Formatted for government and private sector submission in Nepal
- Organisation name, project details, and date auto-populated
- Consistent formatting across all document types

### 4. Rate Analysis
Detailed cost breakdown for each work item showing:
- Material cost
- Skilled labour cost
- Semi-skilled labour cost
- Unskilled labour cost
- Equipment cost
- Overhead and profit percentages
- Wastage percentage
- Final computed rate vs. DUDBC base rate

### 5. Team Collaboration
- Invite team members by email
- Organisation-level roles: Owner, Admin, Member
- Project-level roles: Lead, Estimator, Viewer
- Shared project library — all team members work in the same live project
- Role-based access control — Viewers cannot edit, only view

### 6. Assembly Library
- Create reusable groups of work items (assemblies) for common construction tasks
- Platform-wide templates available for common building types
- Organisation-specific private assemblies
- Assemblies link to DUDBC rate codes — rates resolved automatically when applied

### 7. Project Dashboard
- All projects in one view with status, priority, bid value, and bid due date
- Project statuses: Estimating, Bid Submitted, Accepted, In Progress, Complete, Lost, Archived
- Priority levels: High, Medium, Low
- Filter and sort by any field

### 8. Subcontractor Quote Comparison
- Record and compare subcontractor quotes per discipline
- Track quote status: Received, Under Review, Accepted, Rejected
- Notes and validity dates per quote

### 9. Change Orders
- Document scope and cost changes after project award
- Change order statuses: Draft, Submitted, Approved, Rejected
- Full audit trail

### 10. Custom Rate Schedules
- Import your own rate schedules in bulk
- Create individual custom rate items
- Use custom rates alongside DUDBC rates in the same project
- Rate batches named and versioned by import

## Common Use Cases

### Government Tender Preparation
A quantity surveyor uploads the project drawings for a government school building in Lalitpur. They select Lalitpur district, measure the structural quantities on the PDF drawings, link each item to the relevant DUDBC rate code, and export a complete BOQ and rate analysis in the DUDBC format required for government submission. Total time: a few hours instead of 2–3 days.

### Road Upgrade Project
A contractor preparing a bid for a rural road upgrade in Kaski uses Estimate Nepal to measure road lengths and earthwork volumes from the alignment drawings, apply the district-specific DUDBC rates for Kaski, and generate the Bill of Quantities with full rate analysis for the tender submission.

### Multi-Disciplinary Building Estimate
An engineering firm handling a mixed-use commercial building project uses the discipline system to organise work items: Civil, Structural, Architectural, and MEP as separate disciplines. Multiple estimators work simultaneously on different disciplines, all in the same project.

### Preliminary Budget Estimate
An architect uses Estimate Nepal early in the design phase to generate a rough order of magnitude (ROM) estimate from schematic drawings, using DUDBC rates to give the client a realistic budget before detailed design begins.

### Subcontractor Quote Comparison
A project manager collects quotes from three MEP subcontractors and records them in Estimate Nepal's quote comparison table to evaluate them against the BOQ estimate and each other before award.

## FAQ Summary

**Q: What is Estimate Nepal?**
A: Estimate Nepal is a web-based construction cost estimating platform built for Nepal. It helps engineers, QS, and contractors create BOQs using DUDBC rates, measure PDF drawings, and export tender documents.

**Q: What are DUDBC rates?**
A: Official construction cost rates published by Nepal's Department of Urban Development and Building Construction. They cover all 77 districts and are updated every fiscal year.

**Q: Do I need to install anything?**
A: No. Estimate Nepal is fully web-based and works in any modern browser.

**Q: Is there a free trial?**
A: Yes — 14 days, full access, no credit card required.

**Q: What does it cost?**
A: Plans start at NPR 999/month for a solo user. Team plans at NPR 1,999 (3 users) and NPR 3,000 (5 users). Enterprise from NPR 550/seat.

**Q: Does it cover all 77 districts?**
A: Yes. The DUDBC rate catalog includes district-specific rates for all 77 districts of Nepal.

**Q: Can I export tender documents?**
A: Yes. Export BOQ, rate analysis, measurement books, and full tender documents as PDF or Excel.

**Q: Is it secure?**
A: All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS). Role-based access control. Files stored in secure cloud storage. No data shared with third parties.

**Q: Can my team collaborate?**
A: Yes. Invite team members, assign roles, and work together on live projects. Organisation roles (Owner, Admin, Member) and project-level roles (Lead, Estimator, Viewer) both supported.

**Q: What happens to my data if I stop paying?**
A: Your data is preserved. You lose access to editing and export features on an expired account but your projects remain safe. Upgrade at any time to regain access.

## Technical Details

- **Deployment:** Cloud-hosted SaaS, web application
- **Access:** Any modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) on desktop, laptop, or tablet
- **No install required:** 100% web-based
- **File types supported:** PDF drawings (architectural, structural, civil)
- **Export formats:** PDF, Excel (.xlsx)
- **Database:** Relational database with full audit trail
- **Security:** HTTPS encryption, role-based access, parameterised queries, rate limiting
